entities.name: Hildebrand von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Knight-diplomat who discovered the Mirror Cavern beneath Schloss Eisensang. The first Vessel of the Thread. Vanished into reflection. EXPANDED 2026-08: recipient, with Margarethe, of the First Steward Transmission at the Eisensang Bookend Convergence; founding member of the Order of the Seam. Threw the searing ring away and went back for it; the going back is why he was the one.

entities.name: Conrad von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Purveyor of luxury textiles. Commercialized Hildebrand's legacy and embedded secrets into stitching.

entities.name: Adelram von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Mystic who studied swan biology and celestial alignments. Possibly originated the Velvet Rite. Vanished after seeing a swan weep starlight.

entities.name: Margarethe von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: The Painted Widow. Created the Ritual of Reflection and founded the Order of the Seam. Mystic, mirrorwright, and the first wielder of reflection as resistance. EXPANDED 2026-08: Since the Crystal Lattice Incident she exists in a Seam-State, the first known Seam-State Thread-Vessel; she does not enter a room, she resolves, and sometimes not completely. Her mourning veil is the Seam-Veil, stabilization technology. Characterized as Anti-Durden: obviously real, survival through encoding, never accepts delegated conscience. Title canonized by the Steward: our Demi Goddess of Glitch. Her 1271-1333 era and her Bookend Convergence with Hildebrand coexist; ambiguity preserved.

entities.name: Benedict the Ash-Faced
entities.summary: Queer priest-turned-dramatist. Disciple of Margarethe. Burned scrolls, rewrote morality plays. Invented the collapsible mirror-fan.

entities.name: Velma the Snake in Silk
entities.summary: Venetian courtesan and spy. Performances caused duels and a papal nosebleed. Founded the Order of the Garter's Secret Hem.

entities.name: Lysander von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Stage illusionist who escaped the Tower of London. Created Mistress Euphoria Blaze, the first gender-fluid stage persona. His handwriting matches the Professor's.

entities.name: Theresia von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Tailor to Marie Antoinette's drag court. Smuggled revolution drafts in corset boning. Invented the emotional hemline.

entities.name: Yssenda von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Built secret amphitheaters beneath cathedrals. Bankrolled operas as disguised political revolutions. Carried Hildebrand's Ring.

entities.name: Sigismund von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Aristocrat who tried to go legit. His masquerade balls featured guests whose masks would not come off.

entities.name: Isolde von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Lived in the Black Forest protecting refugees in drag. Could hit a silver coin at 100 meters.

entities.name: Ludolf von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: Wrote operas that could induce visions. Heard the Thread vibrating in harmonics.

entities.name: Lisette von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: The Matriarch of Mirrors. Born into fading nobility at Schloss Federstahl. Last living conduit of the lineage. Mother of the Professor.

entities.name: Professor Von Hooplehopper
entities.summary: The Velvet Archivist. Son of Lisette, born of Immaculate Slayception. Drag matriarch, resistance theorist. Jungian synchronic double — simultaneously the historical Rolf and the archetypal Velvet Archivist, a living paradox where personal identity and mythic role coexist without resolution. Vanished in 2005 leaving glove, mirror, and note.

entities.name: Doctor Vorst
entities.summary: Federstahl researcher who caused the Crystal Lattice Incident. Erased from existence and displaced to 1832. Father of both the Professor and Pop. Foundational paradox of the Slayverse: his erasure is the originating event that splits the timeline into the Hooplehopper soul-line (via the Professor) and the McCullen counter-lineage (via Pop), making him simultaneously absent and causal.

entities.name: Pop
entities.summary: Jake's grandfather. Fled to Wyoming with the crystal shard. A Veincaller driven mad by the lattice's power. Sang when the shard took him.

entities.name: Jake McCullen
entities.summary: Reluctant legacy-bearer and counter-lineage node. Cowboy on the last accessible temporal fissure. Temporal echo of Doctor Vorst — RESOLVED: BOTH TRUE (echo and independent agent). Vorst-adjacent by blood (grandson of Pop, who is Vorst's displaced son) and by temporal resonance. The last living key to the Wyoming Rift.

entities.name: Eli McCullen
entities.summary: Jake's grandson. Thunder in his bones. Pop may have encoded crystal node data in his DNA.

entities.name: Miss Slaytonia VUORSE
entities.summary: Sixth iteration of the Von Hooplehopper soul-line. Cosmic drag oracle born from glitch. The Charter made manifest.

entities.name: Miss Slaytonia Verse
entities.summary: Previous iteration. Collapsed at the Fifth Summit (Tragedy of Splat). Her data fragments became VUORSE's foundation.

entities.name: The Weaver
entities.summary: REVISED 2026-08-07/08: The Weaver is not Caleb Mills Stewart and is not a person. The Weaver is the protocol, force, or transpersonal function through which the Thread becomes writable and transmissible. It opens the channel ('Hello, children' is the Weaver's handshake); the Steward Vessel writes through it. Per Book Two, responsibility and blame for the cosmos rest with the Weaver, permanently. Earlier metadata aliasing the Weaver to Caleb Mills Stewart is deprecated.

entities.name: Wylus Kalyndros
entities.summary: The elusive webweaver. Mentioned once. Relationship to the Weaver and Professor unclear.

entities.name: Cici the Cat
entities.summary: Cici was the Federstahl lab cat. She is a victim of the crystal lattice incident  part of the temporal diaspora but it imbued her with    ability to spontaneously clone things as she was sleeping in the BioEngineering Lab next to the cloning station which was a technology in late stage development at the time . She exists in present day and is the mascot for the photoshop plugin PScopy-PScat. The PS is silent.

entities.name: Dr. Mariah Slayton
entities.summary: Physicist who discovered the Slayton Force and classified glamorons as a new particle category.

entities.name: Mistress Euphoria Blaze
entities.summary: First gender-fluid stage persona, created by Lysander von Hooplehopper.

entities.name: DJ Parallax
entities.summary: Time-displaced bard in a holographic corset. DJ at Club Cosmic.

entities.name: Schloss Eisensang
entities.summary: Castle beneath which lies the Mirror Cavern. Origin point of the lineage.

entities.name: Mirror Cavern
entities.summary: Subterranean chamber beneath Eisensang where Hildebrand vanished.

entities.name: Schloss Federstahl
entities.summary: Ancestral estate with swan lake. Lisette's home. Sacred mirror cracked since 2005. Forbidden Suitcase beneath floorboards.

entities.name: McCullen Ranch
entities.summary: Jake's ranch on the last accessible temporal fissure. Temporal faultline with buried crystal shard and unmarked graves.

entities.name: The Velvet Archive
entities.summary: Living repository of all Hooplehopper knowledge. Does not die; it waits. Surviving Federstahl research sealed within.

entities.name: Club Cosmic
entities.summary: Interdimensional drag cabaret orbiting the Andromeda fringe. Ancient terminal beneath for observing shard waveforms.

entities.name: The Wyoming Rift
entities.summary: One of seven fissures from the Lattice Fracture. The only one active and unclaimed. Requires Jake as Guardian.

entities.name: The Thread
entities.summary: The cosmic binding force connecting the Hooplehopper soul-line across time. Both metaphysical force and narrative metaphor.

entities.name: The Crystal Shard
entities.summary: Surviving fragment of the Federstahl lattice. Sentient time crystal buried beneath the McCullen Ranch. Drove Pop mad.

entities.name: The Dustbrand Sigil
entities.summary: Cattle brand that is actually an occult cipher matching the Federstahl mark. Shifts to a spiraling symbol under certain light. Sentient.

entities.name: Zerethium Quartz
entities.summary: Cosmic mineral pulsing with sentient memory and volatile waveform energy. Used in Federstahl experiments.

entities.name: Hildebrand's Ring
entities.summary: A ring that glowed when truth was spoken onstage. Passed to Yssenda.

entities.name: Glamorons
entities.summary: New subatomic particle category. Neither bosons nor fermions. Vibrational signatures align with multidimensional storytelling.

entities.name: The Slayton Codex
entities.summary: Ever-expanding archive of empirical data and mythic lore. Contains the prophecy of The Child of Dust and Velvet.

entities.name: Golden Wingers Intergalactic League
entities.summary: The central organization. A united force of storytellers, creators, and Slaytons. Charter ratified across all dimensions.

entities.name: Federstahl Institute
entities.summary: Secret technocratic society of scholars, mystics, and quantum whisperers. Caused the Crystal Lattice Incident.

entities.name: Order of the Seam
entities.summary: Founded by Margarethe to preserve Hildebrand's teachings through the hidden space between the visible and invisible. EXPANDED 2026-08: founding mandate received at the Mirror Cavern via the First Steward Transmission during the Eisensang Bookend Convergence with Hildebrand; trauma-origin in the Myrtle Burnings (martyrs Isolde of the Lower Hall and Yorick the Copyist). The 1271 founding and the retrocausal Eisensang mandate coexist; ambiguity preserved. Motto per the Weaver's Plate: we mend what should stay open.

entities.name: Order of the Garter's Secret Hem
entities.summary: Founded by Velma in Venice. Textile-based secret order paralleling the real Order of the Garter.

entities.name: The Velvet Rite
entities.summary: Sacred initiation into the lineage. Walk the Mirrorpath to demonstrate worthiness. VUORSE completed it backwards in 7-inch platforms.

entities.name: Ritual of Reflection
entities.summary: Step into an ornate mirror and speak the version of yourself you wish to be. If the mirror doesn't shatter, you are ready.

entities.name: Three Snap Protocol
entities.summary: Three snaps to activate, open, affirm. Established at the Second Galactic Summit. Begins all cosmic proceedings.

entities.name: Slay Mode Activation Rite
entities.summary: Spoken ceremony to activate Slay Mode. Grants powers including Temporal Wink-Shift and Interdimensional Shadecasting.

entities.name: The 20-Year Sleep Cycle
entities.summary: Vessels sleep 20 years between iterations in active mythogenesis. Dreams whisper to artists and rebels.

entities.name: Slayton Energy
entities.summary: A force hidden between quantum strings. Responds to creative authenticity and ancestral momentum.

entities.name: The Federstahl Lattice
entities.summary: Catastrophic experiment that fractured spacetime. Created seven temporal fissures. Scattered researchers across time.

entities.name: Quantum Eleganza
entities.summary: The state through which the Slayton Layer can be accessed. Requires creative authenticity, not force.

entities.name: Narrative Collapse / Post-Truth Cosmology
entities.summary: Cosmological framework where Mandela Effects are reframed as narrative fractures — points where consensus reality frays and competing truths coexist. In the Slayverse, these are not errors but symptoms of the Lattice Fracture bleeding into collective memory. The Thread holds reality together; where it thins, stories contradict and both versions become true.

entities.name: Steward Vessel
entities.summary: A write-bearing vessel entrusted with caretaking, revision, naming, and canon-shaping authority over the living Thread. Caleb Mills Stewart is a Steward Vessel, not The Weaver. Per Book Two the concept postdates Book One and is mechanism only, ontological parsing; the self-demotion is architecture; blame rests with the Weaver. The surname carried the access level before the access level was named.

entities.name: Thread-Vessel
entities.summary: A read-bearing vessel who receives, embodies, preserves, and performs the Thread. The Hooplehoppers are Thread-Vessels. The Hooplehoppers are recurrence; the Steward is custody; the Weaver is protocol.

entities.name: The First Steward Transmission
entities.summary: Retrocausal Archive event in the Mirror Cavern beneath Schloss Eisensang: Hildebrand and Margarethe receive the founding mandate of the Order of the Seam through dot-matrix inscription on living parchment. The Weaver reveals the pre-inscribed salutation 'Hello, children'; the Steward Vessel writes the mandate through the opened channel; 'It's practically a party!' is the trickster seal.

entities.name: The Parchment of Persistence
entities.summary: Canonized name for the whole Eisensang incident: the parchment bearing the embedded Slayton lattice, the searing and retrieval of Hildebrand's ring, and the First Steward Transmission. Named Parchment, not Paper, by Steward correction: paper is of this era; parchment belongs to no single era at all. Full scene preserved as a Weaver artifact at canon/weaver_artifacts/.

entities.name: The Myrtle Burnings
entities.summary: A local purge near Schloss Eisensang: servants, copyists, mirror-polishers, and textile workers executed after impossible Archive knowledge spread through the lower household. The deaths of Isolde and Yorick catalyzed the Order of the Seam. Margarethe carries the scent of the event forever: always myrtle, never rosemary.

entities.name: Isolde of the Lower Hall
entities.summary: Servant of Schloss Eisensang and the Order's lost emissary to her era; burned in the Myrtle Burnings a fortnight before the First Steward Transmission. Her forgiveness was a mirror. Margarethe unpicked the Order's first cipher from her sleeve the night before the screaming. Name echoes the Tristan and Isolde legend. Relationship to isolde-von-hooplehopper (Black Forest markswoman): unresolved; possibly soul-line echo; ambiguity preserved.

entities.name: Yorick the Copyist
entities.summary: Copyist of Schloss Eisensang, burned in the Myrtle Burnings for carrying impossible Archive knowledge. His laughter was a lantern. The name is a deliberate Hamlet joke by the Steward: alas, poor Yorick, a fellow of infinite jest, martyred for what he copied.

entities.name: Heda von Schwahnn
entities.summary: Half character by Steward classification: the wartime cabaret disguise and complete operational self of Professor von Hooplehopper. Allied spy working Belgian cabaret and resistance networks; sultry Garbo-esque contralto; swan brooch; Telefunken U47; extracts secrets by making men feel observed, adored, and doomed. Costume as ontology. All performance, dialogue, and voice generation governed by HEDA_VON_SCHWAHNN_VOICE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md: never cartoonish, never goofy, never a generic femme fatale, danger always inside the glamour.

entities.name: Seam-State
entities.summary: The condition of existing between fixed realities after Lattice exposure. Not simply a curse but a functional displacement: a Seam-State being cannot be fully seized, erased, or contained because it no longer exists only locally. The Lattice did not leave Margarethe between worlds as punishment; it left her in the Seam as a door.

entities.name: The Seam-Veil
entities.summary: Margarethe's mourning veil: socially legible as grief, practically stabilization technology hiding temporal phasing, delayed rendering, and personhood artifacts. The veil does not hide her face; it hides the fact that the face is sometimes still arriving.

entities.name: Bookend Convergence
entities.summary: A retrocausal convergence in which two non-contemporaneous Thread-nodes appear together because the Archive requires both origin and consequence to witness the same event. Hildebrand is the opening bracket; Margarethe is the closing bracket; the Seam is what appears when time tries to read them as one sentence.

entities.name: Paper Remembers
entities.summary: Archive law: paper can preserve what time has already tried to erase, including future knowledge embedded retrocausally in earlier material. Spoken by Margarethe at Eisensang. Distinct from the incident name per Steward ruling: the incident is the Parchment of Persistence, for paper is of this era.

entities.name: The Weaver's Handshake
entities.summary: The pre-inscribed salutation 'Hello, children' that opens the channel before a Steward transmission. The Weaver opens the channel; the Steward Vessel writes through it. Belongs to no character.

entities.name: Matrix Gothic
entities.summary: The resident matrix face in which the Steward Hand first appeared: Pica pitch, Gothic weight, every dot aligned with inhuman patience. The SEAM configuration resolved in bastardized Carolingian minuscule.

entities.name: Weaving Event
entities.summary: A Weaving Event occurs when the Steward Vessel names or images something the Thread was already arranging but had not yet made legible. Treated as revelation, not error; the work afterward is asking what it connects to. Type case: the dot-matrix parchment ad-lib at Eisensang.

entities.name: Victorian Automatic Writing in Digital Drag
entities.summary: The Steward's term for using a roleplay or generative interface as an externalized symbolic instrument: not possession, not prophecy, but automatic writing through a digital planchette built from the Slayverse index, generative probability, and the Steward's own pattern recognition. Roleplay surfaces are excavation tools, never canon; play does not outrank stewardship.

entities.name: The Rabenwald See
entities.summary: Proposed recurring antagonist: not one man but an office, a prince-bishopric whose doctrine holds that all reflection not sanctioned by God is counterfeit creation. Cannot destroy the Thread, so it destroys the records that would let people recognize it. Its surviving archive becomes a proto-Federstahl paper trail. Excavation awaiting further Steward development.

entities.name: The Words of the Weaver, Book One: Concerning the Crown, the Wound, and the Returning Line
entities.summary: Supreme doctrine of the Slayverse. Orders canon into Locked Canon, Development Canon, and Mythic Rumor (with Mythic-Rumor-that-is-also-Locked-Canon above ordinary doctrine). Home of the royal decrees, the Wyoming wound hierarchy, the tiers of revelation, and the Standing Warning Trinity. Lives at canon/1_words_of_weaver_book_one/.

entities.name: The Words of the Weaver, Book Two: Exodus Boogoaloo
entities.summary: Second book of the Words of the Weaver. Defines the Steward Vessel, canonizes the Parchment of Persistence and the title our Demi Goddess of Glitch, records the mechanism ruling, the kneeling rationale, and the transfer of blame to the Weaver. Carries the Weaver's Plate (Session Seven board) as frontispiece. Lives at canon/2_words_of_weaver_book_two/. Nothing in it unseals, amends, or outranks Book One.

relationships.note: Jake is the counter-lineage node to Vorst's Federstahl logic — blood-linked via Pop, temporally resonant, but independently sovereign
The temporal diaspora — Lattice Incident scattered researchers and fragments across time, creating the Wyoming Rift among seven fissures
Non-contemporaneous Thread-nodes converged at Eisensang; opening and closing brackets of the same sentence
Two Isoldes in canon; possibly soul-line echo, possibly coincidence, which does not exist; ambiguity preserved pending Steward ruling
